subject: Disaster rehearsal evidence & accreditation checklist
messages:
From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@orbitpay.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: evidence from last week

Hi Hannah,

As part of OrbitPay's external review and upcoming SIG/CAIQ intake, our security team needs a consolidated packet showing the April 17 disaster rehearsal you ran with ops. Specifically they asked for: 

- The rehearsal runbook used (versioned)
- RTO/RPO test outputs (metrics, timelines)
- Incident timeline (steps taken, failover times)
- Any gaps discovered and remediation notes
- A mapping doc that ties rehearsal artifacts to SIG/CAIQ control identifiers

Can you please share the evidence packet and a short accreditation checklist that states whether the artifacts map to the CAIQ/SIG controls, or point us to the right place if you've already uploaded it? Our external auditor (Sara Park) is cc'd and needs the packet by end of day Tuesday 4/20 to include in their report.

Thanks, much appreciated.

Emily Zhao
Head of Platform Security, OrbitPay
emily.zhao@orbitpay.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

[Attachment: example-audit-template.docx]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@orbitpay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: evidence from last week

Emily — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Ben (ops lead for the rehearsal) and Marissa (compliance/QA) to assemble the packet.

Action plan:
- Ben: pull the rehearsal runbook (v2.3), attach the RTO/RPO measurement logs and timeline, and mark any gaps observed.
- Marissa: create a brief accreditation checklist that maps artifacts to SIG and CAIQ control IDs (skeleton attached).
- I will review and export a single PDF package for Sara and OrbitPay.

Ben and Marissa — deadline is EOD Tuesday 2027-04-20 for the full packet to Hannah. Please keep items in the Drive folder linked below and add any screenshots/console snapshots to the rehearsal-screenshots zip. If there are any blockers to sharing (e.g., redacted PII requirements), flag them here immediately.

Drive folder: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/BCP-Rehearsal-2027-04

Thanks,

Hannah Schmitt
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
[Attachment: accreditation-checklist-v1.xlsx]

On Sun, Apr 18, 2027 at 11:45 AM Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com> wrote:
> Emily — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Ben (ops lead for the rehearsal) and Marissa (compliance/QA) to assemble the packet.

All — attached are the rehearsal artifacts from 2027-04-17. Highlights below: 

- Rehearsal runbook: runbook-bcp-v2.3.md (in Drive)
- RTO/RPO outputs: rto-rpo-measurements.csv (cold start 23m, cache warm 4m; RPO verified at <=15s for KV snapshots)
- Incident timeline: timeline-20270417.pdf (includes step-by-step timings and who executed each step)
- Gaps & remediation: short notes in gaps-and-rx.md — two items where a manual key retrieval took longer than expected (remediation: automate key access path + test)

I've uploaded the ZIP with screenshots and a PDF export of the log to the Drive link. Per Hannah's ask, everything is in the folder and filenames match the checklist. Also created a one-page summary (bcp-rehearsal-log-20270417.pdf) intended for auditors.

Links & artifacts: 
- https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/BCP-Rehearsal-2027-04 (folder)
- Attachment: bcp-rehearsal-log-20270417.pdf
- Attachment: rehearsal-screenshots-zip-20270417.zip

If Sara needs a CSV export of the raw timestamps, say the word and I'll add it.

Ben Carter
Sr. Manager, Production Operations
ben.carter@redwood.com
[Attachment: rto-rpo-measurements.csv]

From: Sara Park <sara.park@bigfour.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@orbitpay.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: evidence from last week

Thanks, everyone — packet received and currently under review. Quick feedback/questions after a first pass: 

1) The one-page summary is perfect for the board-level attestation. Can you confirm whether the RTO number for the worst-case cold start (23 minutes) includes time to route DNS + cert provisioning? We need that spelled out in the timeline section or as an appendix.

2) For SIG mapping — Marissa, the skeleton looks good but we need the control-level citations (e.g., SC-8, DR-2 equivalents) in the same sheet as the artifact filenames so our intake tool can ingest automatically. Could you revise and re-upload?

3) Please redact any ephemeral user tokens or customer identifiers from the screenshots zip; we will not accept PII in attachments.

If you can address the two items above by EOD Wednesday 2027-04-21, we'll mark the evidence as "complete" in the audit tracker and proceed to the CAIQ intake.

Sara Park
Security Assurance Lead
BigFour Audit LLP
[sara.park@bigfour.com]
